title: Eneo Flows runs reliably and remains easy to change
description: Problem: Flow proper has accumulated runtime, persistence, API, frontend, and testing complexity that needs an evidence-backed production-readiness program. Outcome: operators can trust run recovery and data integrity, and engineers have clear canonical owners and behavior contracts. Scope excludes Flow AI Builder internals; Builder consumes the stabilized Flow contracts.

title: Map Flow architecture risks into an evidence-backed roadmap
description: Read-only audit of Flow proper at commit 7cf9caac. Identify canonical owners, god modules, data-model and runtime failure modes, API/frontend drift, overengineering, test debt, and collision-safe sequencing with Flow AI Builder. Deliver file:line evidence, ranked work items, acceptance tests, risks, dependencies, and a Claude max-effort challenge.
